# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of transcripts is **overwhelmingly non-sales**. The large majority of calls are internal/operations chatter: MTC/TC/tag exchanges for SAIL vs Vizag (RINL) material, bundle/seal verification, driver and loading coordination, invoice/payment-charge reconciliation, courier/address confirmations, and cutting-machine ("G2") operator instructions. A further large chunk (the "Vishal" calls) is personal/family conversation in Hindi/Gujarati with no commercial content at all and must be ignored.

Underneath this noise, a genuine but thin layer of **sales/enquiry calls** is visible across many different customer names (V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, V SRIDHAR, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, Vanniar Narendrakumar, Vidveda Krishnasamy/Vignesh, Vijaya Steels Vijayawada, Zetwork Harish, ZIAVUDEEN SHAMSUDHEEN, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah, Valli P, VASUDEVAN K, V KUMAR, Venkatesan, Yuvaraj Elumalai, VJR Developers, Vijayalakshmi Builder, Vimaladevi K, Vinodini Sharathi, Yasar Feroz Godown, VR Atmos). These calls show rate quoting, quantity negotiation, grade/brand clarification, price objections, stock checks, and order confirmation. Because real sales content is scattered thin across hundreds of short ops calls, this KB is built strictly from the commercially relevant lines found, and keeps claims conservative.

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on what is actually discussed in calls, BSC trades in **long and flat MS/TMT steel products**, not roofing:

- **TMT rebar** — grades FE 500, 500D, 550D mentioned. "இந்த 12 mm உங்களுக்கு SAIL tag வந்திருக்கா Vizag tag வந்திருக்கா" [Did you get a SAIL tag or Vizag tag for this 12mm]. Customers repeatedly ask for **SAIL** vs **Vizag (RINL)** tags/MTC — these are treated as distinct mill sources even when size/price match.
- **CRS (TMT "Sale/Vaisakh" coil-rolled stock)** — "இது 20 mm sale CRS போட்டுருக்கீங்கல்ல?" [You've listed 20mm sale CRS?]; confirmed "CRS-ல 500D தான் sir வரும்... 550 வராது" [Only 500D comes in CRS, 550 is not available].
- **MS Plates / Checkered plates** — thickness 2mm–25mm, standard sizes 2500×6300mm / 2000×6300mm, cut-to-size requests common. "8 mm, 4 by 8-உம், 5 mm, 4 by 8" ordering pattern.
